title: norite logs --json
description:
The machine-readable output of `norite logs tail` (M23): the daemon's log, one `entry` per line of output. It is a stream of objects and not one array, so that `--follow` can be read as it arrives; each line is a whole JSON value.

Versioned source of truth (CLAUDE.md rule 15): a change to what this command prints ships with a change to this file in the same commit. Every field is always present.

The log is a file on the user's machine, and nothing in it is trusted to be what the daemon wrote. A line that is not a JSON object is carried whole in `message` with `unparsed` set. What a terminal would act on is escaped as \uXXXX, as in every other command's JSON.

time.description: When the line was written, RFC 3339 with the offset the daemon wrote, or empty when the line has no time that parses.

level.description: The line's level as written: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal or panic from the daemon. Empty when the line names none. Not an enum, since the file may hold anything.

subsystem.description: The part of the daemon that wrote the line, or empty for the daemon itself.

message.description: The line's message. For an unparsed line, the line itself.

fields.description: Every other field of the line, each value as the line held it. Empty for an unparsed line. A field named time, level, subsystem or message appears here when the line gave it a value that is not a string, or a time that does not parse.

unparsed.description: The line is not a JSON object: a traceback, or something that is not the daemon's.

truncated.description: The line was longer than 16384 bytes. `message` holds its beginning, and `unparsed` is set, since a cut line is no longer JSON.
